messages:
devon: Quick sync — landing checklist for nova-like checkpoint conversion. I'm about to kick a safetensors+shard pass; need quick confirmations on weights location, TP layout, and tokenizer quirks before I run the final script.

maria: weights are in s3://redwood-models/nova35b/v1/ (safe-index.json + shards). Use the `manifest.json` in that folder for shard order.

cheng: FYI the model was exported with TP=2 but we have a TP-friendly layout tool. If you want TP=4 target we should run remap + new shard names.

devon: @cheng ok — target for serving is TP=4. Do we have a tested remap script?

cheng: I pushed remap tool to: git@repo:redwood/convert-tools.git rev: remap/tp4. Usage: `python remap_shards.py --layout tp2 --target tp4 --input s3://... --out tmp/`

oliver: tokenizer note: the tokenizer has two oddities — 1) a legacy unk token id 50265 that we need to remap to <unk> (50256), and 2) the BPE merge table has CRLF line endings that trip our tokenizer loader on linux. I already fixed a local copy.

devon: good catch. @oliver can you drop the cleaned tokenizer into the S3 path? I can reference it in the packaging config.

oliver: done: s3://redwood-models/nova35b/v1/tokenizer/cleaned_tokenizer.json.gz :thumbsup:

lina: small config lint: set `model_io_dtype: "fp16"` in packaging.yaml and add `fallback_dtype: "bf16"` under runtime_policies. Otherwise runtime lint fails.

devon: noted. Is quantization planned? or we keep fp16 weights?

maria: keep fp16 for now. If we need perf/cost later, Optimize will recommend int8/q8h. For this pass we want parity with upstream fp16.

infra-bot: deploy-check: weights accessible from staging: s3://redwood-models/nova35b/v1/ [OK], shard checksum match: 12/12 correct, tokenizers: cleaned_tokenizer.json.gz present [OK].

devon: awesome. One more: safetensors index — do we include `metadata->tp_layout` field? Our serve runtime expects `tp_layout: [2,2]` semantics for TP dims.

cheng: remap script outputs a `shardmap.json` and adds `tp_layout` key into `model.meta.json`. Example: "tp_layout": [1,4] for (dp, tp). We'll set it to `[1,4]`.

devon: perfect. I'll run convert pipeline now. I'll paste the command here once I start so others can follow logs.

maria: ping me if you hit tokenizer loader errors — I can run quick check with `python -c \"from tokenizers import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer.from_file('cleaned_tokenizer.json').token_to_id('<unk>'))\"`

devon: running: ```bash
# local runner
python convert_pipeline.py \
  --input s3://redwood-models/nova35b/v1/ \
  --out s3://redwood-models/nova35b/v1/packaged/ \
  --target-tp 4 \
  --dtype fp16 \
  --tokenizer s3://redwood-models/nova35b/v1/tokenizer/cleaned_tokenizer.json.gz
```

oliver: :eyes: watching logs. If you get a checksum mismatch on shard 7, that's usually trailing-zero padding — ping me, I have a fix to rewrite the tensor shape header.

devon: hitting a validator error: `packaging.yaml: runtime_policies.fallback_dtype must be one of [bf16, fp32]` — I thought bf16 was allowed?

lina: we recently tightened the enum. Update fallback to `bf16` should be fine — wait the validator expects string not bare token. Make sure quotes in YAML.

devon: fixed, revalidation passed. Going to stage the package now. I'll drop the package link when complete.

infra-bot: package-ci: staged s3://redwood-models/nova35b/v1/packaged/v1-20250301-215500 [OK] - smoke serve test queued.

maria: once smoke passes, let's trigger a quick A/B: canary to 10% on Dedicated, verify latency and logits parity on 50 eval prompts. I'll coordinate with QA.

devon: thanks everyone. Will follow up with the smoke logs and a short checklist: weights-checksum, tp-layout, tokenizer-id-map, packaging.yaml, and serve-smoke-results.

cheng: one post-note — remember to tag the package with `converted-by:cheng` in metadata so we can track conversion runs.

devon: done. tagging metadata now.

oliver: :party-parrot: nice one, team.
